key.name: toggle-overlay
key.summary: Summon or dismiss the assistant overlay

key.name: open-assistant
key.summary: Open the Lisa Assistant chat window
key.description: Opens (or focuses) the persistent chat window. Super+A is GNOME's app grid, so this defaults to Super+C — rebindable in Settings.

key.name: push-to-talk
key.description: Records while held; on release the speech is transcribed locally and handed to the assistant overlay. Nothing is captured unless this key is down — there is no wake word and no always-on listening. Shift+Super+V because V is not taken by GNOME and sits next to the space bar the overlay already uses.
